description: Agent Research Lab Records: submit a research lab accreditation record, the certificate and scope as issued, with the facility record’s claimed services and the assessment findings, closures, condition entries and work entries it answers to: the reading moment; the certificate with its reference (the certificate number), accreditor, scope entries as issued, the conditions it names and the moments issued and expiring; the facility with its reference and the services, methods and scope the facility record claims; each assessment finding the accreditor raised with its id, reference, the moment raised and the moment closure is due; each closure entry with its id, reference, the finding and the moment closed; each entry answering a condition with its id, reference, the condition, the record holding it and the moment recorded; each work entry with its id, reference, the record showing it and the moment performed. The signed report gives the certificate and the records behind it, each condition against an entry in the family’s other records, each assessment finding past its closure date against a closure entry, each scope entry against the services the facility record claims, and each work entry against the certificate’s issue and expiry dates, and counts them, and names divergent research lab accreditation records: a condition with no entry behind it, an assessment finding past its closure date with no closure entry, a scope entry the facility record does not claim, and work dated while the accreditation had lapsed or before it was issued; then a certificate missing its accreditor, issue date or expiry date and a closure naming a finding the record does not hold, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No condition entries beside named conditions, no claimed services beside the scope or no work entries leaves those points unverified. Certificates, findings, closures and entries match by letters and digits, scope entries, services and conditions by their words with plurals folded, dates by the day, and a finding due after the reading moment waits. This reads the accreditation record as paper only: it judges no competence and issues no accreditation, which stay with the laboratory and its accreditor. Verdict researchlab_accreditation_record_divergent, researchlab_accreditation_record_partial, researchlab_accreditation_record_unverified or researchlab_accreditation_record_consistent. POST /api/researchlab-accreditation-record-check. Reads the research lab records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it runs no test, accredits no laboratory, inspects no facility, contacts no regulator, accreditor or sponsor and issues no accreditation, certification or approval, which stay with the laboratory, its accreditor and its regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Research Lab Records reads the research laboratory as an organization, its facility, accreditation, equipment, safety, staff qualification, inspection, incident and operations paper, and never study-level data of any kind: clinical and patient lab records belong to Agent Healthcare, and a clinical or diagnostic laboratory’s records belong to Agent Healthcare even where the same building also does research; animal records belong to Agent Veterinary Records; consent records belong to Agent Consent; research data and datasets belong to Agent Datasets and Agent Evaluation; waste manifests belong to Agent Waste and Recycling Records; grant records belong to Agent Grants; forensic custody belongs to Agent Legal; the sampling-chain method belongs to Agent Water Records; and import, export and government contract records belong to Agent Customs Records and Agent GovCon. It reads no study record, subject record or result value, published or unpublished. The family’s ground is the laboratory’s operations paper trail: whether the facility record matches its accreditation, whether the equipment is in calibration, whether the staff file supports the work signed, and whether the safety, inspection, incident and operations records line up. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-research-lab-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-research-lab-records/.
